name: @pipeworx/mcp-pakistan-law

tools.name: pk_search_acts
tools.description: Search Pakistan's federal statute register (The Pakistan Code, Ministry of Law and Justice) by words in the Act title, optionally filtered by year and subject category (Criminal, Civil, Family, Labour, Banking, Evidence, ...). Returns act_id, title, category, citation (e.g. "XLV of 1860") and promulgation date. Title words only, e.g. "penal", "contract", "evidence".

query.description: Words in the Act title, e.g. "penal code".

year.description: Four-digit year of the Act, e.g. "1860".

category.description: Subject category name or number, e.g. "Criminal" or "1".

tools.name: pk_get_section
tools.description: Fetch the text of one section of a Pakistani federal Act, e.g. section 302 of the Pakistan Penal Code 1860 (punishment of qatl-i-amd) or section 497 CrPC. Give act (title words like "Penal Code") or act_id from pk_search_acts, and the section number. Read live from the Ministry of Law and Justice's published copy.

act.description: Act title words, e.g. "Penal Code" (first match is used). Prefer act_id when ambiguous.

tools.name: pk_get_act
tools.description: Overview of one Pakistani federal Act: page count, opening text (title, preamble) and the list of section headings, so you can pick a section for pk_get_section. Give act (title words) or act_id.

tools.name: pk_search_judgments
tools.description: Search judgments of Pakistan's High Courts: Islamabad High Court, High Court of Sindh, Peshawar High Court and High Court of Balochistan (Lahore High Court returns an explicit unavailable result). Give court plus words from the headnote or party names, optionally year of decision and reported_only. Returns case title, case number, law-report citation (PLD, SCMR, PCrLJ, YLR, MLD and others), decision date, bench and the judgment link to read with pk_get_judgment. Example: bail before arrest at the Islamabad High Court.

court.description: Which High Court: islamabad, sindh, peshawar, balochistan (lahore is recognised and returns unavailable). Also accepts ihc, shc, phc, bhc.

query.description: Words to find. Islamabad: headnote or party names (6+ letters work best). Sindh: party names. Peshawar: case title and remarks. Balochistan: case title or citation.

year.description: Four-digit year, e.g. "2024". Year of decision for Islamabad and Peshawar; year the case was filed for Sindh; year inside the citation for Balochistan.

reported_only.description: Only judgments approved for reporting in the law reports (Islamabad, Sindh, Balochistan).

tools.name: pk_get_judgment
tools.description: Read the text of one Pakistani High Court judgment from the judgment_url returned by pk_search_judgments (Islamabad, Sindh, Peshawar or Balochistan). Returns extracted text in pages of max_chars with next_offset; a scanned judgment with no text layer returns found:false rather than an empty string.

offset.description: Character offset to start from (default 0); use next_offset from the previous page.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-pakistan-law forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the pakistan-law pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
